entry.title: I am your shield
entry.summary:
Author: FamilyDontEndWithBloood

Rating: MatureLanguage: EnglishWords: 45,255Chapters: 16/19Kudos: 133

Summary: ~ "I told you," he choked out, his voice a fierce growl right against Merlin's skin. "I am your shield." ~─── If the end of Merlin left you with a "Once and Future Broken Heart", this is the story you were denied. As Merlin defies destiny to drag Arthur back from death, what they uncover is far more than a magic reveal. Driven by a devotion that shatters ancient prophecies and burns through Merlin’s essence, their fight leaves the inescapable truth of their bond laid bare. It is an epic and profoundly psychological journey, tracing the intimate evolution of two men who step beyond unspoken devotion into an unbreakable belonging—a bond growing from destiny to mind, from soul to skin, and finally into flesh and bone. It unfolds through the most subtle touch, the undeniable intensity of their feelings, and the monumental choices shaping their realm. Healing is a gradual journey—from individual sacrifice to a kingdom rebuilding as a whole. Expect a fiercely protective King, a Court Sorcerer by his side as an equal, a rich slow-burn convergence of souls, and the unsparing emotional and physical payoff we were always promised.
